accessNotes: Lucid's new LucidDaily help-center collection was updated on 2026-07-27 and 2026-07-28. The live configurator was not available to the browser session, and the server-rendered homepage does not expose the JavaScript product prices. Only LucidPro's stable undiscounted price card values, exposed on Lucid's own indexed homepage, are recorded. Coupon prices change by capture and are not used. LucidFlex, LucidDirect and all four LucidDaily configurations retain null prices. LucidBlack is excluded because Lucid labels the collection Legacy. LucidMaxx is excluded because Lucid says it is invite-only and unavailable to the general public.

notes: BASE PRICES ONLY: $135 / $185 / $285 / $370 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K. Lucid's indexed first-party cards also display changing coupon prices; no coupon price or code is stored because TradersFundHub has no Lucid affiliate agreement.
ONE-TIME FEE: Lucid says there is no subscription or automatic rebilling. Failed evaluations require a separately purchased reset.
NO ACTIVATION FEE: Lucid states that upgrading a LucidPro evaluation to funded costs $0.
TIER-SPECIFIC TARGETS: $1,250 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000. These equal 5% on $25K and 6% on the other 3 tiers, so profitTargets is null rather than publishing one false product-wide percentage.
EOD TRAILING LOSS: maximum-loss amounts are $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500. The line follows the highest closing balance and locks at starting balance plus $100 after the initial trail threshold.

DAILY LOSS: no DLL on $25K; fixed soft DLLs are $1,200 / $1,800 / $2,700 on $50K / $100K / $150K. A DLL stops trading for the session but is not a hard account breach unless the maximum-loss line is reached.
ONE-DAY EVALUATION: Lucid says LucidPro can pass in 1 trading day and has no published maximum duration.
FUNDED PAYOUT CONSISTENCY: the 40% field applies to the funded payout cycle, not the evaluation. Largest single-day profit divided by total cycle profit must be 40% or less.

PAYOUT GATES: LucidPro requires minimum cycle profit of $250 / $500 / $750 / $1,000 and profit above a buffer equal to initial max loss plus $100. There is no fixed payout window, so payoutFirstDays is null rather than guessed.
PAYOUT SPLIT AND CAPS: 90% to the trader. The first request caps are $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000; later caps are $1,500 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $3,500.
DAY TRADING ONLY: positions close by 4:45 PM ET Monday-Friday; trading resumes at 6:00 PM ET Sunday-Thursday. This excludes overnight and weekend holding.

NEWS AND AUTOMATION: Lucid's general permitted-activities page allows news trading, automated systems and trade copiers. Copy trading is marked restricted because the terms prohibit trading for others, shared risk pooling, and coordinated same or opposite strategies across users.
REFUNDS: after any trading activity Lucid applies a strict no-refund policy; an unused-account refund is discretionary rather than guaranteed.

NEWS RESTRICTION: LucidDaily funded accounts must be flat from 1 minute before through 1 minute after red-folder news; violation is a hard breach.
